# cncdisplay.com - Industrial Video Display Solutions
# Kongto Technology | 深圳市江图科技有限公司
# Last updated: 2026-05-26

## About
cncdisplay.com is the official website of Kongto Technology (深圳市江图科技有限公司),
founded in 2013, specializing in industrial video display solutions. We provide
CRT-to-LCD upgrade modules, industrial video signal converters, and custom
industrial displays for CNC systems worldwide.

## Core Products
- FANUC A61L series CRT-to-LCD upgrade kits (0074 through 0097)
- Mitsubishi MDT962B/BM09DF/FCUA-CT100 CRT replacements
- Siemens 6FC3988/SM0901 LCD upgrades
- Mazak CD1472/C5470/DR5614 display retrofits
- Industrial video signal converters (CGA/EGA/RGB to VGA/HDMI)
- Custom KTV series industrial displays (7-15 inch)
